claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Doha, steps from Souq Waqif and Msheireb Metro Station.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Doha Hotel is a luxury retreat in the Heart of Doha, steps from Souq Waqif and Msheireb Metro Station.

claims.text: Souq Waqif is 0.65 kilometers from the hotel.
Hamad International Airport is 14.2 kilometers from the hotel.
Opus is a Mediterranean restaurant inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean coast.

findings.quote: Opus is a Mediterranean restaurant that serves a diverse array of delectable dishes inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean coast.

claims.text: Opus has a lively open show kitchen with a wood-fired oven.

findings.quote: A lively open show kitchen with a wood fired oven will set the stage for an interactive dining experience.

claims.text: Anis is an all-day healthy eatery serving hand-made food, including gluten-free options, plus coffees, juices and smoothies.

findings.quote: An all-day, healthy food eatery offering delicious, hand-made, nutritionally-balanced food (including gluten-free options), coffees, juices and smoothies.

claims.text: Sora Rooftop serves small sharing dishes, sushi, tempura and robata, meat grilled over charcoal.

findings.quote: With a balance of small sharing dishes, sushi, tempura and the unique culinary art of Robata (meat grilled over charcoal)

claims.text: Sora Rooftop hosts a brunch on Fridays.

findings.quote: On Fridays, Sora Rooftop is open for brunch as well, between 12.30PM and 04.00PM.

claims.text: All rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, window seats and a marble bathroom with a deep soaking tub, rain shower and double vanity.

findings.quote: All rooms enjoy floor to ceiling windows, luxury window seats, and designer marble bathroom with deep soaking tub, rain shower, and double vanity sink.

claims.text: Rooms come with Le Labo bath toiletries and a Nespresso coffee maker.

findings.quote:
- Le Labo bath toiletries
  - Nespresso coffee maker
findings.note: listed in every room type's in-room amenities

claims.text: Valet parking is offered for hotel guests and event visitors.

findings.quote: We offer valet for hotel guests and event visitors.

claims.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.

findings.quote: Our 24-hour in-room dining service offers an exquisite selection of freshly prepared dishes

claims.text: Sora Rooftop sits 21 storeys above Msheireb Downtown, with panoramic views of The Doha Palace, the Green Mosque, Souq Waqif, the Corniche and the Doha skyline.

findings.quote: Perched 21 storey's above Msheireb Downtown, Sora provides panoramic views of The Doha Palace, Green Mosque, Souq Waqif, Corniche and Doha skyline.

claims.text: The Spa spans two floors, with tailored treatments, mood showers, a hot tub, sauna, steam room and ice room.

findings.quote: Spanning two floors, The Spa at Park Hyatt Doha is a destination dedicated to restoration and well-being.
Guests are invited to experience a curated journey through tailored treatments, mood showers, a hot tub, sauna, steam room and ice room.

claims.text: The semi-covered pool and fitness center have dedicated spaces for women and men, with year-round swimming and views across Msheireb Downtown.

findings.quote: the semi-covered pool at Park Hyatt Doha. Featuring dedicated spaces for women and men, high-end cardio and strength equipment and year-round swimming with views across Msheireb Downtown

claims.text: Presidential and Diplomat Suite guests have a private terrace with views over the city or the Corniche.

findings.quote: Presidential and Diplomat Suite guests can retreat to a private terrace with magnificent views over the city or Corniche.

claims.text: Anis offers alfresco dining on Sikkat Wadi, pitched for Doha's milder winter months.

findings.quote: Anis additionally offers alfresco dining on Sikkat Wadi, perfect for enjoying the milder weather during Doha's winter months

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's ultra-luxury positioning.
